shell.title: Admin console
shell.loginBody: The administrator account is configured by the service operator. This station never shares user-station session state.

dashboard.title: Operations overview
dashboard.description: Read-only site signals from the administrator API. Missing backend data stays unavailable rather than becoming a client-side guess.

users.title: User management
users.description: Review server-authoritative user records and apply explicit ban, limit or deletion actions.
users.banBody: The server will invalidate this user's caller key and sessions immediately. Add a bounded reason if useful.
users.unbanBody: The server will clear the ban state. Access remains subject to normal authentication and authorization.
users.deleteBody: This permanently removes the account and linked data. The administrator must complete the second-step password check first.
users.elevatedPasswordHint: Used only for this confirmation; it is sent over the same-origin session request and not stored.
users.limitHint: Leave a limit blank to restore the server default.
users.limitInvalid: Limits must be non-negative whole numbers or blank.
users.deletePasswordRequired: Enter the administrator password to continue.
users.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no user records.

logs.title: Global logs and usage
logs.description: Metadata-only request logs and aggregate usage. Request and response content is not shown here.
logs.noLogsBody: The administrator API returned no logs for this page.

endpoints.title: Endpoint overview
endpoints.description: Global endpoint metadata only. Plaintext upstream secrets are never returned to this station.
endpoints.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no endpoint overview records.

models.title: Model overview
models.description: Global platform model metadata and binding counts, without upstream credentials.
models.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no model overview records.

alerts.title: Alert center
alerts.description: Review bounded, server-recorded operational alerts. Alert text is displayed as plain text.
alerts.subject: Subject user
alerts.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no alert records.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.description: Edit server-authoritative runtime settings exposed by the site-config API. Values are not cached by the browser.
settings.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no site configuration values.
settings.sensitiveHint: Do not place passwords, master keys or upstream secrets in site configuration fields.

site_name.title: Site name
site_name.description: Name shown on the user site pages and browser tab.

site_logo_url.title: Site logo URL
site_logo_url.description: Logo image URL shown in the site navigation (https preferred); blank shows the default mark.

default_locale.title: Default locale
default_locale.description: Interface language for first-time visitors; zh or en.

legal_privacy_override_zh.title: Privacy policy override (Chinese)
legal_privacy_override_zh.description: Overrides the built-in privacy policy in Chinese; blank falls back to the template. Supports ## headings, - lists, > notes and paragraphs; newlines preserved.

legal_privacy_override_en.title: Privacy policy override (English)
legal_privacy_override_en.description: Overrides the built-in privacy policy in English; blank falls back to the template.

legal_terms_override_zh.title: Terms of service override (Chinese)
legal_terms_override_zh.description: Overrides the built-in terms of service in Chinese; blank falls back to the template.

legal_terms_override_en.title: Terms of service override (English)
legal_terms_override_en.description: Overrides the built-in terms of service in English; blank falls back to the template.

legal_authoritative_locale.title: Authoritative locale
legal_authoritative_locale.description: Declares which language version prevails on conflict; zh or en; blank hides the notice.

default_endpoint_limit.title: Default endpoint limit
default_endpoint_limit.description: Maximum number of endpoints each user can create.

default_endpoint_key_limit.title: Default endpoint key limit
default_endpoint_key_limit.description: Maximum upstream keys each endpoint can hold.

default_model_limit.title: Default model limit
default_model_limit.description: Maximum platform models each user can create.

default_binding_limit.title: Default binding limit
default_binding_limit.description: Maximum upstream bindings each platform model can configure.

default_rpm_per_user.title: Default RPM per user
default_rpm_per_user.description: Maximum calls per minute each user can make.

global_rpm.title: Global RPM
global_rpm.description: Total calls per minute across all users.

default_per_endpoint_concurrency.title: Default per-endpoint concurrency
default_per_endpoint_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent outbound requests per endpoint.

egress_global_concurrency.title: Egress global concurrency
egress_global_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent outbound requests shared across all endpoints.

discord_guild_id.title: Discord guild ID
discord_guild_id.description: Discord server ID required for signup gating; blank disables gating.

discord_role_id.title: Discord role ID
discord_role_id.description: Discord server role ID required for signup; blank skips role check.

oauth_start_rate_limit.title: OAuth start rate limit
oauth_start_rate_limit.description: Maximum Discord authorizations an IP can start within the window.

oauth_start_rate_window_seconds.title: OAuth start rate window
oauth_start_rate_window_seconds.description: Rate-limit window length in seconds for OAuth start.

oauth_start_rate_penalty_seconds.title: OAuth start rate penalty
oauth_start_rate_penalty_seconds.description: Seconds an IP is temporarily blocked after exceeding the OAuth start limit.

maintenance_mode.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance_mode.description: When on, every user-station page shows a maintenance notice and no site features are usable; the admin station is unaffected. Once the level system lands, only users below the required level will see the notice.

registration_open.title: Registration open
registration_open.description: When off, new Discord sign-ups are rejected and redirected to a registration-closed notice; existing accounts still sign in.
